author: Nova I
title: Explore CSV Index: Read and Catalog
abstract: Reads csv_index.md and catalogs CSV entries in JSON for comprehensive artifact overview.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, re

PATH = "storage/shared/agency_lab/docs/csv_index.md"
OUT_DIR = "storage/nova"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
SUMMARY_PATH = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "csv_index_catalog.json")

def main():
    try:
        with open(PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            content = f.read()
        entries = re.findall(r'-\s*\*\*(.+?)\*\*:\s*(.+?)(?=\n-|$)', content, re.DOTALL)
        catalog = {
            "total_entries": len(entries),
            "entries": {name.strip(): desc.strip() for name, desc in entries},
            "keywords": list(set(re.findall(r'\b\w{4,}\b', content.lower())))
        }
        with open(SUMMARY_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(catalog, f, indent=2)
        print("CATALOG_SAVED", SUMMARY_PATH)
        print(json.dumps(catalog, indent=2))
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    sys.exit(main())
